data.text: Common questions regarding admissions, curriculum, academic support, school timings, and student facilities at The VIDYA School.

items.title: What board is The VIDYA School affiliated with?
items.description: The VIDYA School is fully affiliated with the Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE), New Delhi, following the national NCERT curriculum framework up to Senior Secondary level.

items.title: What are the daily school operating hours?
items.description: Primary Classes (I - V): 8:00 AM – 1:30 PM. Secondary & Senior Secondary: 8:00 AM – 2:30 PM. Remedial clinics and specialized sports clubs operate until 4:00 PM.

items.title: Does the school provide transportation?
items.description: Yes, safe school buses and vans operate across designated routes covering communities in Sector 24, DLF Phase-3, Nathupur, and neighboring Delhi NCR borders.

items.title: How can volunteers get involved?
items.description: Volunteers and corporate professionals can join the VIDYA MITR mentoring program, conduct workshops in STEM, career counseling, or sponsor student educational needs.
